Arjahn returns the lantern and guides him toward Pristinia; their conversation continues in posts the following day.
questEventConsequences.Vaemyr guides Dorian away from the damag: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. After a recent attack, Vaemyr reassures the caravan musician and takes him toward town. Dorian offers to help; Vaemyr tells him there are ways to serve without fighting.
questEventConsequences.Kasiri and Krasteline investigate the Ga: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. The examination reveals ancient teleportation magic but no discernible internal power source. When Fenwick arrives, he and Kasiri recognise their Jorasco and Medani connections; Krasteline helps him up.
questEventConsequences.Farkur promises a caravan and provides a: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. After danger near the route, Farkur describes his unfinished welcome-caravan project, then escorts the newcomers toward Pristinia and directs them to the tavern. The promised full service remains a project at this point.
questEventConsequences.Pappy and Eldin welcome Pin from Midgard: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. Pin says his people sent him to aid allies called Rahu against Death. Pappy shares coffee and Eldin offers lodging directions, while asking how Pin’s allies relate to the Rahu known here.
questEventConsequences.New arrivals find smoke and siege beyond: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. Alfred and Mei arrive amid smoke and ash. Armed figures attack near the route; after the first encounter, Pristinia is visibly under siege. Further danger follows, so no lasting safe passage is established.
questEventConsequences.Aravil and Icarus evade the Rahu search: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. Aravil warns Icarus to hide. His ordinary-chicken disguise fools the searching soldiers; they withdraw without finding an adventurer. The pair then head toward Pristinia.
questEventConsequences.Neemah reframes the call as work for lif: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. Neemah calls the company to fight for life. Coralyn asks that Joe-Joe’s preferences be heard while others debate his usefulness as a fighter. A welcome becomes a discussion of how he may choose to contribute.
questEventConsequences.Vessalia welcomes Star and hears her own: Source: the-gate.md, reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date; exact in-world date unestablished. Vessalia guides Star to Pristinia and Pilgrim’s Hearth. Star refuses an unsupported claim that her former world is dead, but agrees to help protect this one. Vessalia apologises and reframes her appeal around both worlds.
questEventConsequences.Tarwen welcomes the company to its castl: Castle chronicle · reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date, not an established in-world date. Tarwen confirms the castle is theirs and offers mage-assisted travel to Zarathis. Wheat fields, vineyards and the company’s private discussion establish an earlier residential history than the later political crisis.
questEventConsequences.The castle company weighs the local fact: Castle chronicle · reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date, not an established in-world date. Draygar states his intention to join the Silver Star. Olokun considers the Emerald Veil as a way to learn and help other islands; Elenia remains uneasy about hostility toward the gods. Plans are not completed initiations.
questEventConsequences.Olokun scouts the astral sea and returns: Castle chronicle · reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date, not an established in-world date. With Elenia watching his body, Olokun projects into a star-filled space, sees a distant creature and a possible gate, and returns along his silver cord. He does not reach the gate or establish a safe route.
questEventConsequences.Elenia tends the courtyard altar to the: Castle chronicle · reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date, not an established in-world date. Elenia tends flowers around a courtyard stone and invokes Eugene through her glowing orb. Adelia asks for both missing friends to return. No return is witnessed in this exchange.
questEventConsequences.Adelia proposes a ferryman crossing: Castle chronicle · reviewed scene. Date shown is the UTC posting date, not an established in-world date. After disagreeing over concealing divine worship, the friends discuss Adelia’s ferryman spell. Questions about the Void and safety remain unanswered. Adelia leaves to prepare; no crossing or permanent service is shown.
questEventConsequences.Ada remembers Fenwick’s Vital Chain and: The recognition places healing and community organization within Eovar’s renewal. Fenwick’s contribution becomes a network others can use, while the founding date and complete institutional structure remain unresolved.
questEventConsequences.Tobias guides a party through difficult: His field competence supports the hospitality he shows arrivals: care includes helping companions navigate and rest. The scene’s exact day and location remain unresolved.
questEventConsequences.Fenwick’s tower provides public material: A private residence becomes a repeatable public route to employment. Tobias makes the board accessible to newcomers, while the tower’s precise map position and the notice board’s opening date remain unknown.
questEventConsequences.The tower expedition ends in rescue and: The retreat preserves the party while leaving Hana’s identity and the tower’s purpose unresolved.
questEventConsequences.The harpy cave is collapsed after a fina: Saoirse takes the letter to seek an identification. The fragments’ origin and any connection to the Before remain unresolved.
questEventConsequences.Kazhinju allows the ingredients for Bogd: The mission gains the needed materials without killing the witch. Bogdan’s recovery is not independently shown, and her confession does not explain wider illness.
questEventConsequences.Ryvyt and Pelagia ask questions at the P: Trade and local testimony deepen Larkhollow’s history without resolving the tower or changing routes.
questEventConsequences.Viota’s monument answers with remembranc: The party acquires observations and a translated inscription. Viota’s identity, the lost spring and a possible restoration remain unresolved.
questEventConsequences.Kimi and Kuri ask adventurers to find Ve: Swift’s legacy inspires a new request. The search and liberation are unfinished; the reported route and conflicting refugee reports require verification.
questEventConsequences.Rolen prepares the Archery Range for its: The range becomes a place to make equipment and pass on skills; these scenes record preparations rather than a dated opening ceremony.
questEventConsequences.Pristinia deliberates war in the Public: Public deliberation leads to scouting and organized mobilization, without establishing unanimous agreement on every later policy.
questEventConsequences.Severina dies during an Alpine Forest wo: Later records show Severina active again. The forest export does not establish how she returned, so this is not her final recorded fate.
questEventConsequences.Camilla publicly dissolves the Hellknigh: The Order ends by public declaration. Camilla retains her commitments to law and confronting corruption, announces Voraketh as her destination and leaves the question of a successor institution open.
questEventConsequences.A dreamlike rift remains unsealed: The failed closure remains part of history. The warning establishes unresolved consequences, not proof of a particular later disaster. Source: primary rift-rp transcripts. Displayed source-post dates are not confirmed in-world dates.
questEventConsequences.A clockwork rift opens into hostile mach: The narrator records people leaving while a caged creature protests. Retreat is established; destruction of all machinery or a successful closure is not. The action instruction appears in Cecil’s post, rather than being misattributed as a direct narrator rule. Source: rift-rp-01.md; 1–2 April 2025 source posts.
questEventConsequences.An ooze rift closes with a larger threat: The encounter ends without establishing the destruction of the greater creature. Closing access and defeating everything beyond it are different outcomes. Source: primary rift-rp transcripts. Displayed source-post dates are not confirmed in-world dates.
questEventConsequences.Ritual evidence reveals a sustained brea: The architect and wider connections remain unidentified; this evidence does not assign a creator to every rift. Source: primary rift-rp transcripts. Displayed source-post dates are not confirmed in-world dates.
questEventConsequences.A vast rift leads into a dark expanse: The narrator concludes on the stated assumption that everyone left before it was too late. That assumption is preserved as stated, without inventing individual escape scenes. Source: rift-rp-01.md; 7 August 2026 source posts.
questEventConsequences.An abyssal rift becomes a crisis of alle: The primary scene establishes this as the encounter in which Cthulhu arrives. Pappy’s extraction precedes the completed crossing. The separate rescue record retains the later distinction between observed events and the dispute about character knowledge. Source: rift-rp-01.md; 3–4 September UTC posts, corresponding to 3 September EDT.
questEventConsequences.A volcanic rift collapses after its crys: The separate returns preserve the entry-point pattern despite Djöhandrai’s attempt to follow another traveler. This sequence does not establish a crystal anchor in every rift. Source: primary rift-rp transcripts. Displayed source-post dates are not confirmed in-world dates.
questEventConsequences.A coastal rift opens onto a battle from: The narrator establishes the immediate combat ending and return, rather than leaving the expedition’s outcome unknown. The scene does not establish the fate of all forces elsewhere beyond the breach. Source: rift-rp-02.md; 8 October 2026 UTC posts.
questEventConsequences.Cthulhu comes through a rift into Fenumi: The creator confirms the identity and 3 September 2026 date. The narrator establishes the completed crossing and aftermath; The arrival posts at 02:31–02:37 UTC on 4 September correspond to 22:31–22:37 EDT on 3 September. Claims about the summoner’s motives or complete control remain claims; the god’s later campaigns are not established by this scene. Source: rift-rp-01.md.
questEventConsequences.Ephraith reports Melian’s release after: The peace supplies the political context for the Queen’s report. The delegation’s earlier uncertainty remains part of the history; a report by a party to the conflict is not rewritten as an observed rescue.
questEventConsequences.Bowene exiles Elenia without closing the: Bowene’s stated compromise requires Elenia’s departure while inviting other companions to join. He promises information and material help, schedules departure at sunset, and leaves the door to later legal change open. No fixed term or general return authorization is established.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The new vanguard entrusts leadership to Severina
questTimelineAdditions.people: Lady Severina Blackveil; Pelagia; Thorn; Camilla Blackwood; Kasiri Ruza; Modeli; Kumai-218
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Kumai-218 asks six candidates to define leadership and choose whom they would follow. Kasiri and Camilla entrust the role to Severina for her judgment, discipline, and duty. Kumai then joins the arena contest; Kasiri wins, and he asks the company to discuss its leader and report back.
questTimelineAdditions.consequence: Peer trust and martial competence are both tested; the contest does not by itself finalize the appointment.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Severina turns the new vanguard into an organization
questTimelineAdditions.people: Lady Severina Blackveil; the forming Veilguard
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Severina reports that she has gathered people, selected a name, and begun seeking equipment for rapid response beyond one settlement. The April leadership exercise is becoming an institution in practice.
questTimelineAdditions.consequence: The new vanguard gains the logistical shape needed to operate as a lasting faction rather than an improvised quest party.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Veilguard name enters the public record
questTimelineAdditions.people: Lady Severina Blackveil; Veilguard; Ahau
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Severina publicly uses the name Veilguard while discussing the Ahau, support for newer adventurers, and preparation for a wider Great War. The forming company now has a public identity and mission.
questTimelineAdditions.consequence: The Veilguard becomes a named public faction, separate from both the earlier Vanguard and the Ale-Chemy Knights.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Veilguard prepares to recover Thorn
questTimelineAdditions.people: Lady Severina Blackveil; Thorn; Veilguard
questTimelineAdditions.summary: After Thorn dies during a husk hunt, reports say a cult intends to use her in a ritual against one of Gael’s Shards. The Veilguard pools resources, and Severina promises to bring her home.
questTimelineAdditions.consequence: The attempt to bring Thorn home becomes the first major test of whether the Veilguard’s language of mutual protection survives catastrophe.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Thorn returns and names the Veilguard as home
questTimelineAdditions.people: Thorn; Lady Severina Blackveil; Veilguard
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Thorn’s body is found on 6 September, yet by 19 September she is alive in Prima and says she belongs with the Veilguard. Her words define membership as mutual watchfulness and obligation.
questTimelineAdditions.consequence: The Veilguard’s identity is confirmed from within by a returned member, while the mechanism of her return remains an open question rather than fabricated lore.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The first Called arrive in Prima
questTimelineAdditions.people: Jiangshi; Adelia; Scribonia; Gartina; Jako; Quake; Forgax
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A forgotten portal stirs, Cala and Nuru appear through avatars, and the first recovered company sees the settlement that will become its new home.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The newcomers scout beyond Pristinia
questTimelineAdditions.people: Uras; Quake; Gartina; Claire; John; Scribonia; Forgax
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A road patrol spots something massive moving miles to the west and discovers a branch that becomes lifeless when removed from John.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Melian gives the newcomers a town to improve
questTimelineAdditions.people: Melian; Scribonia; John; Quake; Jiangshi; Adelia
questTimelineAdditions.summary: During a hard rain, Melian convenes the newcomers over a map and leads them through the settlement whose needs will shape their earliest work.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Forgax follows the pillar only he can see
questTimelineAdditions.people: Forgax; Jiangshi; Quake; Claire; Jako; Scribonia
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Forgax leads companions toward a mountain pillar of floating onyx stones and ash that remains invisible to everyone else.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A trapped route to Eovar is reopened
questTimelineAdditions.people: Jiangshi; Scribonia; Rolen; John; Adelia; Forgax
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party breaks a trap along the route and reaches the final hill overlooking Eovar Harbor and the Thundering Coast.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Weary Traveler sends a rescue party
questTimelineAdditions.people: Quake; Gartina; Jiangshi; John
questTimelineAdditions.summary: At the Weary Traveler’s request, a party leaves the main gate to find his missing friends, carrying recovered armor, bows, and swords.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia organizes militia, medicine, and land
questTimelineAdditions.people: Melian; Quake; Gartina; Rolen; Claire
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Melian divides volunteers among militia planning, medical work, material searches, and a survey of usable land as Pristinia adapts to its growing population.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The ritual-site assault is stopped
questTimelineAdditions.people: Cobble; Vigr Frami; Alyhotep; Scribonia; Scout Lilian; Nerias
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A hunter’s warning leads the adventurers to corrupted pale creatures gathering at an old ritual site; the force is defeated before it can overrun Pristinia.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The mine dead and the missing companions are recovered
questTimelineAdditions.people: Rolen; Vigr Frami; Loistava; Pappy; Alyhotep; Cobble
questTimelineAdditions.summary: After fighting through the mine encampment, Rolen and Claire recover fallen adventurers and locate the Weary Traveler’s missing companions.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia celebrates rescue and resurrection
questTimelineAdditions.people: Melian; Herb; Gartina; Jako; Cobble; Rolen
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The Common Man hosts a feast for the town’s rescue and the return of the dead, while the celebration also records how many defenders were lost.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Four volunteers answer the militia’s call
questTimelineAdditions.people: Alyhotep; Vigr Frami; Cobble; Rolen
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Four chosen adventurers report behind the archery shop to begin preparing Pristinia’s new volunteers for real danger.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A fog expedition reveals a hidden watcher
questTimelineAdditions.people: Cobble; Rolen; Vigr Frami; Kyle Derelia; Scout Lilian
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A patrol enters a road swallowed by cold fog; afterward Cobble glimpses an armored figure examining the party’s path before vanishing.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The adventurers drill Pristinia’s volunteers
questTimelineAdditions.people: Rolen; Carandolchanar; Elenia; Quake; Adelia; Loistava; Alyhotep
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Returning adventurers run the new militia through a controlled course under Rolen and Carandolchanar’s supervision.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A dying messenger brings Eovar’s warning
questTimelineAdditions.people: Rolen; Quake; Elenia; Alyhotep
questTimelineAdditions.summary: An exhausted outsider reaches Pristinia asking for help in Eovar; the resulting pursuit ends with an enemy vessel burning and the command to destroy a mysterious Compass.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia’s palisade and moat take shape
questTimelineAdditions.people: Rolen; Ryvyt; Elenia; Quake; Nienna; Jako
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Logging crews and builders raise a treated-log palisade, dig a staked moat, and bring the first watchtowers near completion.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A forest expedition finds a dead priest’s room
questTimelineAdditions.people: Elenia; Cobble; Talon; Vigr Frami
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Four adventurers explore the forest at Pristinia’s edge and find an overgrown priest’s room holding only his bones.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia makes a pact with the wolves
questTimelineAdditions.people: Cigal; Adelia; Quake; Nienna; Rolen
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Rather than exterminate the wolves, the party establishes Cigal as an intermediary: the pack will protect the farm if the town helps when game is scarce.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Seven glyphs open an underground city
questTimelineAdditions.people: Cobble; Rolen; Bitoshi; Adelia; Vigr Frami; Jako; Melian
questTimelineAdditions.summary: After triggering the last defenses at a sealed door, the party sees seven glyphs hanging above an underground city lit in purple.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A Flying Horror escapes with lost intelligence
questTimelineAdditions.people: Cobble; Adelia; Rolen; Bitoshi; Vigr Frami
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Inside the ancient tunnels, poor coordination allows a Flying Horror to escape, costing the party information and exposing Pristinia to future threats.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia holds after its allies abandon it
questTimelineAdditions.people: Quake; Alyhotep; Loistava; Ryvyt; Scout Lilian; Melian
questTimelineAdditions.summary: With Rolen gone and the Travelers absent, townsfolk and remaining adventurers finish the defenses and repel the attacking force.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The mountain party survives the storm cave
questTimelineAdditions.people: Bitoshi; Quake; Loistava; Adelia
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A mountain expedition barricades itself in a freezing cave; the shelter prevents exposure but the storm allows only a short rest.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Eovar epidemic is traced to the water
questTimelineAdditions.people: Symin; Alyhotep; Uthgar; Gartina; Ryvyt; Tricks
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Investigators entering post-quarantine Eovar find disease in the water and begin tracing the outbreak through the port’s crowded districts.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A celestial test reveals the Wyrm’s hunger
questTimelineAdditions.people: Symin; Tricks; Elenia; Alyhotep; Idril; Cala
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A clear-sky bolt draws the party to a radiant trial; when the test ends, the heavens vibrate with the nearby hunger of the Wyrm.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Symin falls beyond the Gate
questTimelineAdditions.people: Symin; Bari; Tavorchanor
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Symin answers a rescue plea alone, is killed near the patrol’s ambush site, and has his body carried away by bark-covered undead.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Narrows reveals Eovar’s sanitation failure
questTimelineAdditions.people: Tricks; Dale; Ryvyt; Jako; Alyhotep
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party finds the outbreak’s greatest concentration around a refuse-filled canal beside the Flying Jib, exposing the city’s mixing of water and waste.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The mountain-pass party clears an undead valley
questTimelineAdditions.people: Wren; Quake; Adelia; Bitoshi
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Wren guides the company away from a flood-prone valley, and the party survives an undead attack before reaching the waiting host.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia adopts merchant penalties by two votes
questTimelineAdditions.people: Melian; Hawthorne; Swiftfoot; Adelia; Bari
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A packed Common Man votes 31–29 to include penalties for merchants in a new proposal, preserving one of Pristinia’s earliest recorded legislative decisions.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Two captured doppelgangers are sent home
questTimelineAdditions.people: Loistava; Nienna; Dale; Saray; Bari
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party resists the captives’ psychic surge and banishes both doppelgangers, with Nienna sensing that they reached their own world alive.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The walking dead reach Pristinia’s approaches
questTimelineAdditions.people: Loistava; Wren; Vigr Frami; Alyhotep; Cobble; Saray; Dale; Adelia
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A scout’s dying warning precedes an undead horde; after the defense, the party confronts the polluted ground and necrotic remains left behind.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A reality-splitting ritual is foiled
questTimelineAdditions.people: Quake; Wren; Elenia; Adelia; Dale; Saray; Alyhotep
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Quake’s corrupted-radiant staff points toward rival beacons; the party stops the ritual, but its last-minute destruction buries most of the evidence.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The meteor orb opens after the spider falls
questTimelineAdditions.people: Sildithas; Saray; Dale; Elenia; Quake; Bitoshi; Scout Lilian
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A race toward a fallen meteor ends when Saray’s arrow kills a giant abomination and the sealed orb slowly opens for the party.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Passage is secured toward the Thundering Coast light
questTimelineAdditions.people: Olokun; Loistava; Nienna; Adelia; Bari; Alyhotep
questTimelineAdditions.summary: With Eovar’s quarantine lifted, the party goes to the docks to obtain passage toward the beacon shining beyond the Thundering Coast.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Nienna is found bound in a forest clearing
questTimelineAdditions.people: Nienna; Tricks; Olokun; Loistava; Gartina; Adelia; Ephraith
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Scout Lilian leads a company to a dead body and five dark-clad figures surrounding Nienna, who is restrained by Dimensional Shackles.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A landslide exposes the four-pillar ruins
questTimelineAdditions.people: Wren; Nienna; Olokun; Dale; Arjahn; Elenia; Adelia
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party explores an oval chamber exposed by the landslide that killed Fernir, mapping geometric pillars and recovering additional journal entries.

questTimelineAdditions.title: A sea expedition discovers a new island
questTimelineAdditions.people: Loistava; Dale; Olokun; Lucido; Alyhotep; Targas Tarmile
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A keelboat expedition leaves Eovar, threads towering sea cliffs, and hauls itself onto a high platform to confirm a previously unrecovered island location.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Before’s distress call proves to be a lure
questTimelineAdditions.people: Arjahn; Olokun; Swiftfoot; Lucido; Scribonia
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A familiar distress frequency draws explorers into The Before, where a hidden figure imitates the plea for help; the party escapes into daylight.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Rehevä’s cliffside dragon nest is cleared
questTimelineAdditions.people: Olokun; Bari; Dale; Adelia; Loistava; Mayor Jovaz
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party descends a rope ladder beneath Rehevä, fights young dragons in the cliffside, and returns to a town celebration led by Mayor Jovaz.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Nienna’s condemned sailors return to service
questTimelineAdditions.people: Nienna; Saray; Quake; Gartina; Szerafin
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party reaches sailors awaiting execution as mutineers; by the end of the mission they salute Nienna, provision her ship, and help carry the company back to Pristinia.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The party breaks the harbor blockade
questTimelineAdditions.people: Elenia; Dale; Quake; Saray; Gartina; Huoth
questTimelineAdditions.summary: After scouting and planning in heavy rain, the company acts against the bridge blockade and follows Huoth into a tower filled with powerful magic.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The colossal archway’s false floor is found
questTimelineAdditions.people: Olokun; Scribonia; Alyhotep; Bari
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Explorers testing a colossal entrance discover a flickering square where the apparent floor gives way beneath a probing spear.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Rahu open their Pristinia enclave
questTimelineAdditions.people: Scribonia; Swiftfoot; Olokun; Captain Hildethrax; Sildithas
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The newly raised Rahu structure opens to the public after sunset, revealing a rigid nocturnal community and an altar-like focus glowing violet.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The screaming dungeon’s blood altar is cleansed
questTimelineAdditions.people: Olokun; Vaemyr; Scribonia; Alyhotep; Eugene; Bari
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Following a woman’s echoing screams, the party reaches a blood-covered altar; the blood boils away and a voice promises Alyhotep that he will pay.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia’s quarry corridor is stabilized
questTimelineAdditions.people: Olokun; Swiftfoot; Leo; Sylvaaran; Gareth
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Workers’ fears bring adventurers to the quarry, where Sylvaaran creates a seamless support brace and restores the failing corridor ceiling.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Water guardians emerge in the sector dungeon
questTimelineAdditions.people: Leo; Olokun; Scribonia; Vaemyr; Eugene; Alyhotep
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The explorers penetrate another protected room; when Saturnia disrupts its water, four elemental guardians emerge.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The lich’s lair collapses
questTimelineAdditions.people: Scribonia; Wren; Leo; Vigr Frami; Olokun; Cobble; Arjahn; Vaemyr
questTimelineAdditions.summary: After Melian objects to bringing an undead woman into town, the expedition ends beyond a portal beside the collapsed lair of the slain lich.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Rehevä forgets an unseen act of heroism
questTimelineAdditions.people: Scribonia; Vaemyr; Grokthar; Leo
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A violent arcane revelation in Rehevä tears the adventurers away, leaving the people they protected unable to know what the party accomplished.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The dungeon survivors return to a mayor’s reward
questTimelineAdditions.people: Olokun; Scribonia; Vaemyr; Eugene; Alyhotep; Bari
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party emerges alive from the death-rigged dungeon, surprising a mayor who believed them dead and rewards each survivor.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Gudlaug and Beefy Boy win the race
questTimelineAdditions.people: Gudlaug; Vaemyr; Olokun; Leo; Baron Ironsack
questTimelineAdditions.summary: A hazardous public race ends with the crowd acclaiming Gudlaug and Beefy Boy as the winners.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia’s townsfolk openly support the adventurers
questTimelineAdditions.people: Wren; Vaemyr; Olokun; Sylvaaran; Eugene; Gudlaug; Scribonia; Melian
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Residents who still believe in the adventurers arrive with tools and labor, and the day ends at Melian’s estate with hard-won practical instruction.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Azarian Peaks expedition reaches the storm
questTimelineAdditions.people: Leo; Gudlaug; Olokun; Liora Fenwick; Scribonia; Eugene
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Guided by Liora’s studies, the expedition crosses the sea and climbs into a storm among the Azarian Peaks, where even a dead ice creature glows with magic.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Jiangshi’s coffin reaches Gael’s shore
questTimelineAdditions.people: Jiangshi; Quake; Saray; Elenia; Wren; Dale; Scribonia; Adelia; Bitoshi
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Sailors land the coffin on Gael’s rocky shore while Adelia carries the weakened Jiangshi safely out of the water.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The worm hunt traps the party underground
questTimelineAdditions.people: Arjahn; Gudlaug; Leo; Tricks; Vaemyr; Scout Lilian
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Following Scout Lilian’s map of strange worm sightings, the party collapses a cave and seals itself inside with a fainter remnant of the haze.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The corruption cave leaves its explorers defeated
questTimelineAdditions.people: Olokun; Vaemyr; Gudlaug; Leo
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The explorers leave an otherworldly cavern physically themselves again but carrying a profound sense that the darkness followed them out.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Wrath drives the tomb expedition toward retreat
questTimelineAdditions.people: Elenia; Quake; Wren; Scribonia; Gartina; Bitoshi; Adelia; Saray
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Heavy blows shake the sealed tomb while ravens scout outside, forcing the wounded company to choose between pressing on and returning home.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The cave-trapped party digs free with a crystal
questTimelineAdditions.people: Arjahn; Gudlaug; Tricks; Vaemyr; Leo
questTimelineAdditions.summary: After hours of digging, the trapped explorers clear the collapse; Arjahn recovers crystal fragments and feels a wave pass over him.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Delerium fragments rain outside Pristinia
questTimelineAdditions.people: Arjahn; Tricks; Eugene; Sylvaaran; Vaemyr; Leo
questTimelineAdditions.summary: An explosion scatters pulsing violet fragments across the field beyond the wall and leaves the survivors knowing they must hunt the haze-born spectre.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Gael tomb mission escapes through the statues
questTimelineAdditions.people: Elenia; Gartina; Wren; Quake; Saray; Scribonia
questTimelineAdditions.summary: The party completes its mission under Wrath’s shadow when the crowned Quake commands ancient statues to reveal an escape tunnel.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Moirah returns with Jiangshi at a cost
questTimelineAdditions.people: Moirah; Jiangshi; Elenia; Scribonia; Wren; Gartina; Adelia; Saray; Dale
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Moirah returns carrying Jiangshi’s body after an unseen struggle and is visibly diminished until Elenia’s prayer-like magic restores her.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Pristinia debates gold, business, and public need
questTimelineAdditions.people: Melian; Olokun; Arjahn; Caravash; Zerthimon; Ziegler; Hiram
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Melian and the elders confront a major financial decision as adventurers offer gold and argue over business growth, ordinary residents, and skilled construction.

questTimelineAdditions.title: The Gael mechanism drains nearby magic
questTimelineAdditions.people: Scribonia; Gartina; Elenia; Saray; Dale
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Explorers force an ancient wheel to turn; magic drains from everyone nearby and their connection to the Weave vanishes until the mechanism settles.

questTimelineAdditions.title: Magnus returns and Hope withers
questTimelineAdditions.people: Adelia; Jiangshi; Bitoshi Nakamoto; Alyhotep; Magnus Niriin; Moirah; Dumuzi
questTimelineAdditions.summary: Adelia invokes Divine Intervention for a friend’s second chance. Moirah returns Magnus from Death’s possession and rebukes her; Magnus accepts Dumuzi’s gift, wounds Hope and flees. Adelia attempts to save the tree, then struggles with rage and guilt while Jiangshi and her companions remain.

entries.name: Scout Lilian

rating.reason: Warnings, scouting infrastructure and the cost of her loss shape Pristinia’s history.

quotes.title: “It’s okay Dale. Hope is more important than any one of us. Besides, I will live on....in your hearts.”
quotes.speaker: Nienna

quotes.title: “I walk because they cannot, and I shine... where they are gone.”
quotes.speaker: Melian Starguard

quotes.title: “So afraid. Like a child in the night. They'll see. You can't fool them forever.”
quotes.speaker: Swift Foot · 6 August 2024

quotes.title: “Each night is a success. Trust us, we count our sleeps.”
quotes.speaker: Quille

quotes.title: “Sing the names of those you know but see no longer. Resist the erasure of your past with all you have.”
quotes.speaker: Gartina

quotes.title: “We all break at some point. What matters is that we put ourselves back together. We don’t have to be the same as we were before. We don’t even have to be similar. We just have to live on.”
quotes.speaker: Arjahn

quotes.title: “My pain. Not everyone’s.”
quotes.speaker: Olokun

quotes.title: “Eye for an eye leaves the whole world blind. Can't see the carrot patch in the grass.”
quotes.speaker: Swift Foot

quotes.title: “We've all been in situations where we chose violence first. It worked out then that our mistake didn't cost us. All I'm saying is we consider that our first plan shouldn't be to kill when we do not understand the context.”
quotes.speaker: Vaemyr

quotes.title: “but what I’ve learned is not to enter into something without full knowledge of what I’m agreeing to.”
quotes.speaker: Vessalia · Dark Signs · p. 14 · excerpt

quotes.title: “Forget the Hallowing! Save our allies!”
quotes.speaker: Dale

quotes.title: “We kill and we die to protect this realm, but we, over everything else, protect!”
quotes.speaker: Olokun

quotes.title: “You’ve got to have a code.”
quotes.speaker: Gartina

quotes.title: “They make you smile again. That makes them precious.”
quotes.speaker: Dale

quotes.title: “We got stories. Stories are what keep people going. Keep the old walking and the young from growing weary.”
quotes.speaker: Omari

quotes.title: “The way I fight death is that I focus on keeping others alive.”
quotes.speaker: Arjahn

quotes.title: “I think Cala was calling me... but maybe I was just hopeful.”
quotes.speaker: Elenia

quotes.title: “I am not your teacher anymore, you do not owe me an explanation in every aspect of your life.”
quotes.speaker: Scribonia

quotes.title: “We don’t lack power. We lack knowledge.”
quotes.speaker: Ithilrûnë

quotes.title: “It’s good to have a little doubt. We call that wisdom.”
quotes.speaker: Huoth

quotes.title: “For me the gods graces have been fickle, but our family and our ancestors have never failed…. Their magic has sustained me and even grown recently.”
quotes.speaker: Jiangshi

quotes.title: “Keep what is most truly you from flickering out.”
quotes.speaker: Sildithas

quotes.title: “our story is in service, and out of sight.”
quotes.speaker: Kaiya Dragonsister

quotes.title: “I quickly begin to lose myself, falling into pure instinct. Losing thought.”
quotes.speaker: Murr the Old Wolf

quotes.title: “I know it’s beautiful and bad. The spiral blesses with deep speech and curses with my body….I don’t understand its beauty fully. Will I always be like this?”
quotes.speaker: Fenwick d'Jorasco

quotes.title: “We are Eovar.”
quotes.speaker: Fenwick d'Jorasco

quotes.title: “I will do it myself need to be better and stronger to prove my convition”
quotes.speaker: Karnak · 29 April 2026 posting date

quotes.title: “Yes... it make me, less foccussed on bad memories...”
quotes.speaker: Nymera · 6 September 2025 posting date

quotes.title: “Hope is dead. Only Ambition remains.”
quotes.speaker: Magnus Niriin

quotes.title: “The world broke my beloved. Now I break it. Welcome to my pain.”
quotes.speaker: Roderick / Wrath

quotes.title: “He is an armed and willing combatant. It is not murder. Please do not desecrate our ancient rites with crass words.”
quotes.speaker: High Lord Bowene

quotes.title: “Sometimes pain must be endured to ensure victory. I understand that. Do you?”
quotes.speaker: Aria / Pride · 26 October 2025

quotes.title: “Attachment like that is weakness, it holds you back. Even now you are powerless to help them.”
quotes.speaker: Aria / Pride · 9 October 2025

quotes.title: “Then make this your people. Bring humanity to new heights, so we can reshape this world, in our image.”
quotes.speaker: Aria / Pride · 10 October 2025

quotes.title: “I write things down before people can make them tidier than they really were.”
quotes.speaker: Starojoss Destranoth

quotes.title: “I want to find a way to reunite the islands as they once were.”
quotes.speaker: Adelia

quotes.title: “Union without limit is not harmony.”
quotes.speaker: Ancient Druidic inscription

quotes.title: “Aria was one of us. The best of us. No one here can turn to their neighbor and say they were her equal.”
quotes.speaker: High Lord Bowene
